description: Ultimate SnapOrtho card style: cloze Text + Extra + ortho resource fields. Empty resource fields collapse on the card face.

fields.name: Text
fields.description: Primary cloze body. Use {{c1::...}} markup.

fields.name: Extra
fields.description: Extra teaching text after reveal (tables, pearls, differentials).

fields.name: Orthobullets
fields.description: Curated Orthobullets-aligned teaching bullets (original/edited text you own).

fields.name: Orthobullets_Link
fields.description: Bare HTTPS URL to the Orthobullets topic (or deep link).

fields.name: ROCK
fields.description: ROCK chapter/section citation + curated teaching points.

fields.name: ROCK_Link
fields.description: Bare HTTPS URL / locator for the ROCK chapter.

fields.name: Classifications
fields.description: Classification systems (Neer, Garden, Schatzker, etc.) — text and/or licensed images.

fields.name: Anatomy
fields.description: Anatomy / approach anatomy notes and licensed figures.

fields.name: Nailed_It
fields.description: Nailed It Ortho episode title, timestamp, and 1–3 takeaways.

fields.name: Nailed_It_Link
fields.description: Bare HTTPS URL to the Nailed It episode.

fields.name: Podcasts
fields.description: Other podcasts (OrthoJOE, JBJS, specialty shows) — titles + takeaways.

fields.name: Podcasts_Link
fields.description: Bare HTTPS URL(s) for generic podcasts. Prefer HTML list if multiple.

fields.name: Video
fields.description: VuMedi / Orthobullets video / approach video title + notes.

fields.name: Video_Link
fields.description: Bare HTTPS URL to the video.

fields.name: Millers
fields.description: Miller's Review / Concise Orthopaedics citations and points.

fields.name: OKU
fields.description: OKU chapter reference and curated points.

fields.name: Campbells
fields.description: Campbell's Operative Orthopaedics chapter/page citation and points.

fields.name: OITE
fields.description: OITE-related teaching points (not copyrighted full stems).

fields.name: CasePrep
fields.description: SnapOrtho Case Prep packet summary and/or deep link HTML.

fields.name: BroBot
fields.description: Optional BroBot deep link or prefilled prompt context (IDs preferred).

fields.name: Additional_Resources
fields.description: Catch-all for other curated resources.

fields.name: Missed_Questions
fields.description: Wrong-question notes / OITE misses (user or curated).

fields.name: One_by_one
fields.description: Reserved for sequential cloze control (type yes or c1,c3). Not used by template v1.

fields.name: Personal_Notes
fields.description: User private notes — never synced centrally.

fields.name: SnapOrtho_ID
fields.description: canonicalCardId — do not edit

fields.name: SnapOrtho_Version
fields.description: canonicalCardVersionId — do not edit

fields.name: SnapOrtho_Installed_Hash
fields.description: central-sync hash of installed content — do not edit
